Correctly recorded in docs/runbooks/traffic-moves.md 'Open limits' and plan task 2.3g; the first traffic run is task 2.3h [b] deferred:daniel. Not a defect of this phase.

No Cloud Build run has run any edited file, so submit-time acceptance and the rendered 8-character tag are static analysis only. The strategy (P2.6) records this class of limit; Phase 4 live proofs remain the gate.

N3 (owner: none, process): Green ran one combined verbose run instead of the seven per-task gate jobs of P2.5, and one plan-evidence commit. Each task's case set passed inside the combined run, no test file changed after Red (git diff 413467c3a..HEAD -- scripts/ci/__tests__ empty), and this review re-ran the full suite at the pinned HEAD (102/102), so the evidence still proves each task.

Matches the expected 102.

Check 1 (${BUILD_ID:0:8}, resolved by the PM order): the four push files (accounts, primary-advantage, storytime, workbooks) now hold --tag=<prefix>-$${BUILD_ID:0:8}. Cloud Build substitution turns $$ into one literal $ (documented escape; Google's cloud-build-local subst.go matches keys [A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]* only), bash then slices the step env BUILD_ID=$BUILD_ID to 8 characters. The submit-time rejection risk of my earlier review is closed by the escape; the escaped form is also safe under the scanner because the braced-key regex cannot match a key with a colon. F-17 forbids the unescaped form in all 16 push and traffic files.

Check 1 delta tests keep their strength: assertEscapedTag (W-11-primary/storytime/accounts/workbooks, W-15) requires the exact escaped text, requires env BUILD_ID=$BUILD_ID, and rejects any unescaped ${BUILD_ID:0:8} via /(^|[^$])\$\{BUILD_ID:0:8\}/. W-15 renders the tag at 11 characters and asserts combined 24 <= 46. F-06 expects the escaped form and adds the same unescaped-tag rejection. F-17 asserts files_checked=16 before the loop (A4 input guard) and flags any ${key} whose key fails ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ while legitimate ${_...} keys pass.
Check 2 (tag rule): tagLength plus service length is <=46 for every gated row of scripts/ci/apps.json (max 32, primary-advantage); W-10 covers the 8 rows with rows_checked=8.

Check 3 (traffic files): primary, accounts, marketing use --to-tags=${_TAG}=100 with no _TAG default, so a manual run without the substitution fails closed under MUST_MATCH. Primary order is refuse-legacy-db, migrate-db, doctor-check (--required-migration 0074_primary_help_events kept), update-traffic. Sales order matches AC-2.12 with verify-curriculum-backup first and capture-legacy-rollback before verify-repair-verify-legacy-rollback; the sales _PUSH_BUILD_ID substitution has no default. The capture-script latest-created check (N1) is a recorded limit for task 2.3h, not a phase blocker.

Check 4 (table and select contract): the Q10 table change holds (6 gated rows project: reading-advantage, 2 rows primary-advantage, www and reading-advantage keep $PROJECT_ID; key set and row count unchanged). The Q12 select contract holds: step id select, jobs select/deploy in cd-www-reading-advantage.yml, jobs select/build in cd-apps.yml, outputs www and matrix, strategy.matrix.include from fromJSON, --config and --project from matrix.

Check 5 (no traffic move): git grep at 09ce375d2 finds no update-traffic, no --to-latest, and no cloudbuild-traffic reference in .github/workflows. cd-apps.yml holds zero 'run services describe' calls. Both CD workflows declare permissions: contents: read exactly, Node 22, fetch-depth: 0, and no id-token or pull_request_target. Workbooks fails closed: no Cloud Run service and no workbooks-cloud-run account exist (task 2.3i [b] deferred:pm).

Check 6 (combined Green run): recorded as N3. The per-task case sets are named in the plan notes, the Red tests were not edited after the Red commits, and this review's independent run at the pinned HEAD passed 102/102, so the combined run still proves each task.

A4: F-17 and the W/F loops assert their input sizes first (files_checked=16, gated_rows=8, files_checked=2/4/9). Red r3 proved the new assertions reject partial repairs: a scratch copy with only the storytime tag escaped failed with invalid_substitutions=3; the all-four-escaped copy passed. Earlier partial-repair proof (6 partials, partials_rejected=6) stands.
A3: all counts in the new and changed tests are labeled integers (files_checked, invalid_substitutions, rendered.length). No bare-digit matching found.

A5: the plan's round-2 evidence honestly records the intermediate red state (Green run at 586981581 EXIT=1 with F-06 failing until Red r4 09ce375d2) and the final claims match this review's independent run (EXIT=0, 102 passed). No 'all checks pass' claim contradicts an actual exit.
